dialogues.speaker: Toda
dialogues.text: Alas, O nation of Eternity...

dialogues.speaker: Toda
dialogues.text: ...Ah, hello. What can I do for you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You are...

dialogues.speaker: Toda
dialogues.text: My name is Toda. I am the liaison between the Yashiro Commission and the Grand Narukami Shrine.

dialogues.speaker: Toda
dialogues.text: My daily work is to handle all the issues in the shrine, such as fund raising, allocating manpower, and such...

dialogues.speaker: Toda
dialogues.text: All trivial matters, I know. Still, it is my solemn honor to be working for the Kamisato Clan.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me a little more about the Kamisato Clan.

dialogues.speaker: Toda
dialogues.text: Within the Kamisato Clan, the Commissioner Kamisato Ayato is in charge of all the Yashiro Commission's affairs. Miss Ayaka is in charge of everything in the mansion.

dialogues.speaker: Toda
dialogues.text: Inazuma's Tri-Commission have some really complicated relationships with each other. Although the Yashiro Commission is the least controversial among them, it is still very busy.

dialogues.speaker: Toda
dialogues.text: As such, Sir Kamisato doesn't really stay in the mansion too often. If you need something from the Kamisato Clan, it's better that you visit Miss Kamisato or Mr. Thoma.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You look very worried...

dialogues.speaker: Toda
dialogues.text: Ah, you noticed... I've heard from the shrine maidens that more and more people wish to abolish the Sakoku Decree.

dialogues.speaker: Toda
dialogues.text: If the Sakoku Decree cannot bring happiness to Inazuma, what kind of impact will it have on the other nations in Teyvat...

dialogues.speaker: Toda
dialogues.text: ...I don't really have a conclusion for now. But as a member of the Yashiro Commission, all I can do is trust in the Almighty Shogun.

dialogues.speaker: Toda
dialogues.text: If it is the Shogun's decision, then it must be beneficial to Eternity...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Toda
dialogues.text: Aye... see you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You look very worried...

dialogues.speaker: Toda
dialogues.text: Well... I wouldn't call it "worry" exactly. With the Sakoku Decree's abolition, I'm sure that Inazuma will undergo some changes.

dialogues.speaker: Toda
dialogues.text: I can't be sure what effects this reopening will have on the other nations of Teyvat...

dialogues.speaker: Toda
dialogues.text: ...But though I can't say anything conclusively at the moment, as a member of the Yashiro Commission, all I can do is trust in the Almighty Shogun.

dialogues.speaker: Toda
dialogues.text: If it is the Shogun's decision, then it must be meant to achieve Eternity somehow...
